description:
## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
LabelsLive trash action in table and edit modal; use existing hero-trash and BOModal.confirm_dialog. Preview usage before confirmation, show resource counts and preserve pending form on cancel. Refresh usage and require reconfirmation if it changes.
## Tests to add before implementation
Table and modal entry points, used-label counts, cancel preservation, successful cleanup, changed usage second confirmation, staff cannot delete.
## Branches/paths validated
Manager-only controls; authorization remains in backend; staged edit form preserved behind confirmation and restored on cancel; successful delete closes forms and resets pagination safely.
## Mocking plan
Real LiveView and Event dispatch, no backend mocks.
## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
BO component guide and ongoing consolidated E2E scenario tracking; author new E2E only after existing UX gate.
## Action reuse assessment
Reuse Labels deletion Action through LabelEvents/NodeRouter, DesignSystem.Button hero-trash, BOModal.confirm_dialog. No duplicate mutation or new modal shell. Depends on backend deletion task.
title: Add label deletion controls and usage-aware confirmation UI
